entities.name: Everardus Antonius M. Baaij
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Everardus Antonius M. Baaij was a Dutch bishop of the Roman Catholic Church in South Africa. At the time of his death, he was the oldest bishop belonging to his religious congregation.
